verdict.rationale: First-party docs show a dedicated Experimentation product with Bayesian statistical decision-making for picking winning variations, and pricing lists A/B Tests and Experiments. Metric type selection is documented, and the community confirms multivariate flags exist. The evidence is mostly titles, so depth on multivariate experiment setup and result reporting is thin. missing for 10: explicit evidence of multivariate experiments (not just multivariate flags), detail on results/winner reporting UI, independent hands-on corroboration of experimentation.
